what: Superlative claims on the live dumbmodel.com model cards that have been checked against their artifacts, keyed by a hash of the claim TEXT.
why_hashed: A clearance is for a SENTENCE, not a location. If the text changes, the verification is void and the claim returns to UNCHECKED. Keying by slug+location instead would let a re-extraction inherit the previous sentence's clearance — the same stale-verification defect this repo has been correcting everywhere else.

verdicts.TRUE: checked against the named artifact and it holds
verdicts.OVER_FIRE: the detector matched but the sentence makes no rank claim about data

entries.claim: QB also carries the worst points error (6.371 MAE vs 3.486 for TE) and the widest 80% conformal band
entries.evidence: projections.json -> model.report.per_pos_mae = {QB 6.371, RB 4.397, WR 4.109, TE 3.486}; QB is the max. conformal_q_by_pos = {QB 10.29, RB 6.808, WR 6.657, TE 5.412}; QB is the max.

entries.claim: Week 18 is the worst of all 17 scored weeks and Week 17 the second worst; the peak was 0.744
entries.evidence: eval_backtest.json -> overall.per_week has 17 entries mapped to weeks 2-18. Sorted ascending: wk18=0.561 lowest, wk17=0.652 second lowest, max=0.744.

entries.claim: so the worst busts never appear at all
entries.evidence: Describes a selection effect (careers under 4 seasons are dropped), not a rank claim about a value in the data. Nothing to check.

entries.claim: it lists Jefferson as Robinson's third-closest comp at 0.986 similarity
entries.evidence: projections.json -> players[Wan'Dale Robinson].comps = [A.J. Brown 0.998, Rashee Rice 0.991, Justin Jefferson 0.986, ...]. Third position confirmed by the adversarial verifier on 2026-08-03.

entries.claim: Jackson is Dart's closest comp at 0.986
entries.evidence: projections.json -> players[Jaxson Dart].comps[0] = Lamar Jackson 0.986. Confirmed by the adversarial verifier on 2026-08-03.

entries.claim: Chase carries the highest projected receiving yardage of any WR in the file at 70.9 a game
entries.evidence: projections.json -> Ja'Marr Chase line.rec_yds = 70.9 is the max among all WRs AND all players in the file; next is JSN at 70.3. Exhaustively checked by the adversarial verifier on 2026-08-03.

entries.claim: McBride is the only tight end anywhere in the model's top 50 overall, at #16
entries.evidence: projections.json -> Trey McBride rank_overall = 16, and he is the only TE with rank_overall <= 50. Exhaustively checked by the adversarial verifier on 2026-08-03.

entries.claim: The worst busts leave the league before they accumulate a career
entries.evidence: Same selection-effect statement as the gridiron one. Not a rank claim about a stored value.

entries.claim: the top-1 nearest neighbour of a player-season shares its position label 85.3% of the time
entries.evidence: 'top-1 nearest neighbour' is the NAME of a metric, not a superlative claim about a ranking. The 85.3% figure is a plain statistic and was verified CLEAN by the pitch verifier.

entries.claim: Transfermarkt is the only real one and scraping it at corpus scale is neither polite nor reliable
entries.evidence: A quoted judgement from probe_pitch_expectation_sources.py, presented as a quotation with attribution. Not a computed rank claim.

entries.claim: 'viking' appears at both venues in 2021 and in no other year at either
entries.evidence: tennis_sponsors.json -> CONFIRMED_detail.viking = [Birmingham years_present [2021], Eastbourne years_present [2021]]. No other year at either venue.

entries.claim: mean draw progress lands on 7.0 - the top of the observed scale
entries.evidence: pipeline/data/tennis_matrix.npz -> DRAW_PROGRESS_MEAN over mask-observed rows: min 1.0000, max 7.0000. Exactly one row sits at the max.

entries.claim: declared archetypes that are actually assigned to a row anywhere in the asset
entries.evidence: assets/unified.json -> archetypes[] declares 12; distinct players[].cross_arch across all 20,719 rows is exactly 6: A0, A1, A2, A3, A5, A11.

'top 10' is the METRIC'S NAME (retrieval_top10_hit_rate_informational), not a rank claim the page is asserting. Every number in the insight verified against data/analogy_triples_report.json: hit rate 0.0, mean_b_rank 2114.18, random_expected_rank 2067.15, better_than_random_ratio 0.978, curated arch_agreement 0.65 vs random 0.1621; and analogy_report.json G4 0.9828 vs random 0.1712.

how_keyed: text_sha = sha256 of the whole whitespace-normalised field. Any edit to that field voids the clearance and the claim returns to UNCHECKED.
